items.title: Career Counselling
items.description: One-on-one guidance to help you choose the right course and career path, including preparation support for the International English Language Testing System (IELTS).

items.title: Test Preparations
items.description: Preparing for tests can be stressful, but SSW Training Centre Nepal is here to help — with structured practice sessions and mock tests for every stage of your journey.

items.title: Hostel Facility
items.description: We understand that finding a comfortable place to stay is essential for our trainees, which is why we offer safe, affordable hostel accommodation close to the training center.

items.title: SSW Training
items.description: We provide hands-on training programs to equip you with the skills needed for Japan's Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visa, across categories like caregiving, construction, and agriculture.

items.title: JFT
items.description: Japanese language is crucial for a successful life and career in Japan. Our JFT-Basic preparation classes build the everyday communication skills you'll need from day one.

items.title: Visa Guidance
items.description: Navigating the visa process can be complex and time-consuming, but at SSW Nepal, our team guides you through every document, deadline, and interview — start to finish.
